title: Nasty Aerated Light Egyptian Yakhinja Pilaf
description: A sweet, light and airy Egyptian pilaf using self-raising flour that's perfect as a snack or dessert. Low-carb-friendly.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Add honey syrup and stir until it's fully melted and combined with the almond milk.
Gradually add self-raising flour, stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Cook on medium-high for about 2 minutes or until the mixture thickens slightly.
Fold in a pinch of salt if using (optional).
Serve immediately as is, or let cool and serve chilled with fresh fruit.
